data.gender_notes: Arifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has acquired knowledge and is well-versed in various fields of learning. The name Arifa carries the meaning “The Knowledgeable One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arifa usually hope their child will grow to embody the knowledgeable one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the quest for knowledge and wisdom in the path of spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Arifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Knowledgeable One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arifa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arifa holds significant cultural value in the Islamic world. It is derived from the Arabic words 'arf' meaning 'knowledge' and 'a' referring to 'having'. Hence, Arifa implies a well-versed, knowledgeable, and educated individual. This name was held in high esteem throughout Islamic history, with many scholars, saints, and noblewomen carrying the name. Arifa embodies the cultural ideal of continuous learning and intellectual pursuit, emphasizing the importance of knowledge in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Arifa is rooted in the Islamic concept of seeking knowledge as an essential act of faith. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) declared, "Seeking knowledge is an obligation on every Muslim." (Sunan At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 46). The name Arifa, symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge, which is a means to gain nearness to Allah, the Almighty. Arif At-Rahman, a term used in Islamic spirituality, refers to one who has attained an intimate and deep understanding of God through knowledge and wisdom. Thus, Arifa represents the spiritual journey towards gaining profound wisdom, self-enlightenment, and ultimately, a deeper, more intimate relationship with the Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "The Knowledgeable One" symbolizes A person who has acquired knowledge and is well-versed in various fields of learning.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Arifa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of the knowledgeable one.
